key_provisions_or_claims: Federal, provincial/territorial and municipal governments share responsibility for CAV road safety.
Motor Vehicle Safety Act requires imported and sold vehicles to comply with Motor Vehicle Safety Regulations; 2018 update added flexibility and enforcement powers.
Section 9 allows exemptions from safety standards for new technologies; temporary import allowed for testing.
Voluntary tools: Safety Assessment for ADS, Vehicle Cyber Security Guidance, VCAT, testing guidelines 2.0.
Manufacturers must notify Transport Canada of defects; Transport Canada works with ISO, UNECE WP.29 and US DOT.

It lists voluntary frameworks and guidance (cyber security, safety assessment, testing guidelines) and explains exemptions and temporary import rules for testing non-compliant vehicles.
